title: Arcade Clicker Game
author: jalyper
selftext: Rewards precision - consecutive orbs collected enable you to reach more of the play area in a single click.  Kill orb-eaters before they starve you of orbs.  Get enough 'flow', unlock the 'flash-cut' ability which allows you to kill anything you click within a short timeframe.  All audio is generated in real time using oscillated sine waves, randomly playing notes mainly on the pentatonic scale, with some major sevenths and sus-4s occasionally thrown in.   Stop moving for too long, game over.  All coded in a single html file using Opus 5.  Used Claude Design for assets.
